likelihood.name: End of Life / End of Support
likelihood.description: Level to which the technology used is out of support, i.e. technical support, upgrades, patches, and new features

levels.anchor: Already out of support
Very high likelihood technology will be out of support
High likelihood technology will be out of support
Medium likelihood technology will be out of support
Low likelihood technology will be out of support
Very low likelihood technology will be out of support

likelihood.name: Expired Vendor Contract
likelihood.description: Level to which support contracts for services are due to expire with no replacement agreement

levels.anchor: Already out of vendor contract
Very high likelihood vendor contracts will expire with no replacement agreement in place
High likelihood vendor contracts will expire with no replacement agreement in place
Medium likelihood vendor contracts will expire with no replacement agreement in place
Low likelihood vendor contracts will expire with no replacement agreement in place
Very low likelihood vendor contracts will expire with no replacement agreement in place

likelihood.name: Lack of Knowledge and Skills
likelihood.description: Prevalence of personnel with skills and knowledge to provide support and make changes to the asset

levels.anchor: Already insufficient expertise
Very high likelihood that expertise to provide support or make changes to the asset will become an issue
High likelihood that expertise to provide support or make changes to the asset will become an issue
Medium likelihood that expertise to provide support or make changes to the asset will become an issue
Low likelihood that expertise to provide support or make changes to the asset will become an issue
Very low likelihood that expertise to provide support or make changes to the asset will become an issue

likelihood.name: Inability to Meet Current or Future Business Needs
likelihood.description: Technical inability for asset to meet current or future business needs (e.g. inability to be scaled or have improvements applied)

levels.anchor: Already not meeting current business needs
Very high likelihood that the system will be unable to meet its business needs
High likelihood that the system will be unable to meet its business needs
Medium likelihood that the system will be unable to meet its business needs
Low likelihood that the system will be unable to meet its business needs
Very low likelihood that the system will be unable to meet its business needs

likelihood.name: Unsuitable Physical Environment
likelihood.description: Degree to which the asset is based on old hardware or housed in improper physical environment (e.g. due to climate, location)

levels.anchor: Hardware or physical environment is currently unsuitable
Very high likelihood level of concern regarding the suitability of the hardware or physical environment
High level of concern regarding the suitability of the hardware or physical environment
Medium level of concern regarding the suitability of the hardware or physical environment
Low level of concern regarding the suitability of the hardware or physical environment
Very low likelihood level of concern regarding the suitability of the hardware or physical environment
Security vulnerabilities known to currently exist
Very high likelihood that security vulnerabilities exist
High likelihood that security vulnerabilities exist
Medium likelihood that security vulnerabilities exist
Low likelihood that security vulnerabilities exist
Very low likelihood that security vulnerabilities exist

likelihood.name: Historically Recorded Issues
likelihood.description: Evidence of historical failures or issues

levels.anchor: Issues or failures are currently occurring
Severe issues or failures have occurred in recent past
Major issues or failures have occurred in recent past
Moderate issues or failures have occurred in recent past
Minor issues or failures known to have occurred in recent past
No issues or failures known to have occurred in recent past

impact.name: National Security Impact
impact.description: Impact of a failure of the system directly or indirectly resulting in a threat to national security, health, personal safety or loss of human life

levels.anchor: Very high sustained impact, including threats to health, personal safety or loss of human life
High impact to national security, health, personal safety or loss of human life
Medium impact to national security, health, personal safety or loss of human life
Low impact to national security, health or personal safety
Very low impact to national security, including threats to health or personal safety

impact.name: Reputational Impact
impact.description: Impact to perception of UK Government and scale of intervention to manage damage to reputation

levels.anchor: Very high impact to perception of UK government, requiring major intervention at a parliamentary level to manage reputation
High impact on perception of UK government, requiring significant intervention to manage reputation
Medium impact on perception of UK government, requiring some intervention to manage reputation
Low impact on perception of UK government, requiring little intervention to manage reputation
Very low impact on perception of UK government, requiring no intervention to manage reputation

impact.name: Direct Financial impact
impact.description: Financial impact, either absolute or percentage of departmental budget, that would result from regulatory, litigation, citizen redress or other direct costs including exist-costs and break-clauses

levels.anchor: Very high impact e.g. >10% or >£50m of impact, related to regulatory, litigation, citizen redress, and other direct costs
High impact e.g. 8-10% or £21-50m of financial impact, related to regulatory, litigation, citizen redress, and other direct costs
Medium impact e.g. 5-7% or £11-20m of financial impact, related to regulatory, litigation, citizen redress, and other direct costs
Low impact e.g. 1-4% or £5-10m of financial impact, related to regulatory, litigation, citizen redress, and other direct costs
Very low impact e.g. <1% of departmental budget or <£5m of financial impact related to regulatory, litigation, citizen redress, and other direct costs

impact.name: Direct External Stakeholder Impact
impact.description: Impact on external stakeholders, including economic loss and/or significant inconvenience

levels.anchor: Very high impact on external stakeholders, including economic loss and/or significant inconvenience
High impact on external stakeholders, including economic loss and/or significant inconvenience
Medium impact on external stakeholders, including economic loss and/or significant inconvenience
Low impact on external stakeholders, including economic loss and/or significant inconvenience
Very low impact on external stakeholders, including economic loss and/or significant inconvenience

impact.name: Operational Impact
impact.description: Extent of resource hours lost or additional workload hours required following outage

levels.anchor: Very high impact e.g. >500,000 resource hours of idleness or increased workload
High impact e.g. 100,001-500,000 resource hours of idleness or increased workload
Medium impact e.g. 1001-100,000 resource hours of idleness or increased workload
Low impact e.g. 101-1000 resource hours of idleness or increased workload
Very low impact e.g. <100 resource hours of idleness or increased workload

impact.name: Impact on other Systems (Technical Barrier to Innovation)
impact.description: Level of difficulty in improving the system due to significant codependency on other systems

levels.anchor: Very high barrier to innovation, e.g. highly integrated with other systems, significantly increasing build cost or duration for other projects
High barrier to innovation
Medium barrier to innovation, e.g. integrated with some systems, sometimes increasing build cost or duration for projects
Low barrier to innovation
Very low barrier to innovation, e.g. no interactions with other systems

interpretationNotes: These are original criterion-specific anchors, including financial and resource-hour examples; do not interpolate or repair gaps in the published bands.
The older numeric threshold for calling an asset legacy does not determine classification under the updated definition.
Older register/submission instructions in the source snapshot are historical; current reporting arrangements require confirmation.
Bundled rubric availability is independent of evidence about a project system. Missing system evidence still leaves a score unknown.
